findings.evidence: The proof’s sole use of `IsRootSystem` is `IsRootSystem.span_root_eq_top` at line 54; Mathlib’s `IsRootSystem` definition has separate `span_root_eq_top` and `span_coroot_eq_top` fields (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Defs.lean:117-120`).
findings.fix: Prove a general faithfulness theorem from an explicit root-span hypothesis, derive the `[P.IsRootSystem]` roadmap theorem as a wrapper, and expose corresponding general subgroup/automorphism finiteness and cardinality results.
findings.issue: `indexHom_injective` and all results derived from it through line 105 inherit `[P.IsRootSystem]`, whose `span_coroot_eq_top` field is unused; faithfulness of the index action only needs `span R (range P.root) = ⊤`.

summary: The faithfulness argument and every derived finiteness/cardinality theorem unnecessarily require the full root-system typeclass, although only root spanning is used.
